report.paraphrase: A settings knob capping total model spend during an automated code-writing run's early thinking stages; going over that limit ends whole runs outright.
Pluggable port for an add-at-tail, mutation-free record of what happened during a run; callers add entries or fetch all in insertion sequence.
Driver that has a language model generate a missing internal package, vets the output, retries briefly, then writes accepted results under a staging directory.
Behavior-tree leaf making one language-model round trip: it fills a role-specific prompt template, sends it, then stores the reply on the shared blackboard.
Common wrapper that drives an autonomous model session editing project source directly, logging consumption into ledgers, converting failures into values instead of raising exceptions.
RAM-backed test double offering the same history-recording port as the real disk-backed one; optionally pre-seeded, it lets suites skip filesystem I/O.
